page_title: ARS 2-0 WOL | Arsenal v Wolves 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Daniel Podence (Wolves) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
90+2' Matt Doherty (Wolves) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
90+2' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+1' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The free kick is delivered by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
88' Yellow card! It's like Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jarred Gillett agrees and books him.

85' Daniel Podence (Wolves) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
85' Substitution. Declan Rice did his best and is replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
84' The substitution is prepared. Craig Dawson (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rayan Ait-Nouri.
84' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joao Gomes.
84' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Chiquinho (Wolves) replaces Jorgen Strand Larsen.
83' A clumsy foul by Thomas Partey (Arsenal) and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
80' Substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Bukayo Saka walks off.
80' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' One of the players from Wolves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
75' Substitution. Rodrigo Gomes leaves the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Podence (Wolves).
74' 2 - 0 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:0.
72' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
71' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

71' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

70' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
69' Here's the change. Oleksandr Zinchenko leaves the pitch and Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
68' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
67' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
66' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

65' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
65' Great teamplay by Wolves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

62' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
60' Jarred Gillett rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).

59' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
57' Today's match ends for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde who will be replaced by Matheus Cunha (Wolves).
55' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
51' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
48' Good clearance! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45+1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Declan Rice (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' What a great touch by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.

43' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
41' That's a well-taken pass by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
41' A cross into the box from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared.
40' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
39' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Toti (Wolves) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

37' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
36' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

36' David Raya pulls off a fantastic save! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
35' The total number of attempts is 7:2.
33' Foul! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
32' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
31' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
30' Gabriel (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jarred Gillett no option but to blow his whistle.

29' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
28' Gabriel (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

25' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Bukayo Saka and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Jose Sa was helpless.
23' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
23' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
22' The resulting corner, taken by Declan Rice (Arsenal), comes to nothing.

21' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Bukayo Saka finds Declan Rice (Arsenal) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
19' The keeper makes a simple save after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul and Jarred Gillett immediately signals a free kick.
16' Some trickery by Gabriel Martinelli allows him to set up Ben White (Arsenal) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker.

15' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Jose Sa guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
15' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
14' Ben White (Arsenal) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
14' Ben White (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It's a throw-in for Arsenal.
11' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
10' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
8' Declan Rice (Arsenal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
5' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Declan Rice (Arsenal) took the corner.
4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal). The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
4' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Arsenal win a free kick.
2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), but the defence gets it clear.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jarred Gillett.
